evidence.snippet: Click the links below to learn more about Satisfactory Academic Progress, Tech's SAP Policy, Financial Aid Termination, and submitting appeals!
Financial Aid Termination The SAP Appeal Process SAP Policy What is SAP?

Students who do not meet one of the three above requirements when evaluated at the end of any given spring semester are placed on Financial Aid Termination and must submit a SAP Appeal to potentially regain their aid for the upcoming semester.

A student placed on Financial Aid Termination cannot utilize their eligible federal or state aid until they either return to 'Good Standing' by meeting the SAP requirements for future semesters or submit a SAP Appeal for review that is then approved.

Students placed on FA Termination receive an email notification from the Office of Financial Aid titled "TTU Financial Aid Information" that directs them to Eagle Online to view their Financial Aid Termination status - selecting the status redirects students to the Satisfactory Academic Progress webpage to learn more about Financial Aid Termination and submit a SAP Appeal.
The SAP Appeal Process Students placed on FA Termination who wish to continue using their aid can complete and submit a SAP Appeal for review.
